title: What's Coming in Plug & Prosper 1.3.0
body:
Changes include, but are not limited to:

- More customer avatars, with unique personalities and no duplicate active customers.
- Special customer effects: floating `Zzz`s, `BARF!` jumps, Grandma's cable-pulling cough, robot expressions, lamp glow, inventor glint, ghostly anti-gravity, and coffee steam.
- New physical workshop devices: a pluggable clock, gravity compass, Shape Reader, and rechargeable batteries.
- Day events that change gravity and workshop behavior.
- More customers and pressure as the days progress, balanced with recovery periods.
- A between-day victory screen with daily and cumulative scores.
- Persistent progress across days, restarts, and resumed games.
- Physical plugs, adapters, batteries, and tools that collide, stack, fall, and interact.
- Sticky boards and additional sockets for organizing increasingly busy layouts.
- Between-day upgrades—including better cables, longer shifts, calmer customers, cheaper sockets, and bigger payouts.
- Larger Phone Size mode, improved touch controls, and better mobile-Web support.
- A cleaner, more readable HUD and Settings screen—still WIP, and suggestions are welcome!

[Play Plug & Prosper](https://smallloopworks.itch.io/plug-prosper) · [AI Browser Game Jam 4 results](https://itch.io/jam/ai-jam-4/results)
